slides.title: Fled Moyale. Now being counted in Kenya.
slides.body: Update: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 3, 2026

slides.title: people reportedly crossed into Kenya
slides.body: Since fighting in Moyale intensified in late October, Addis Standard reports.

slides.title: Registration has begun
slides.body: Kenyan authorities, UNHCR and Kenya Red Cross began registering arrivals around Oct 31 at sites incl. Harhosa and OMC camps, Marsabit County.

slides.title: Wristbands, then aid cards
slides.body: Each person, incl. children, gets a blue wristband with an ID code. Household profiling and assistance cards are to follow.

slides.title: Sheltering in schools and churches
slides.body: Many stay at sites such as St. Mary's, Manyatta Burji and Sessi, or with relatives. Needs: food, water, shelter, health care, protection.

slides.title: appeal for three months
slides.body: Sought by UN agencies and partners to support the response, Addis Standard reports.

slides.title: Protect civilians on both sides of the border.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Nov 3, 2026
